rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of a compound with 'sahasreṣu'
locative plural indicating the vast number
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of 'pīḍitāḥ' is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
